patch_description: Add an orthogonal entangling sublayer using nearest-neighbor XX gates around the ring (0-1,1-2,...,7-0), all sharing a single new parameter "xx_ring". This is inserted between the existing ZZ ring and the backward CNOT ladder. XX (X-basis) coupling is complementary to the ZZ (Z-basis) coupling already present and to the RY-based state preparation, giving the circuit richer entangling structure that can better separate hard-to-classify samples (improving worst-group margin) while adding only one extra trainable parameter (5 distinct params total, still very economical).
